title: MaxStyle: Adversarial Style Composition for Robust Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Auxiliary style-augmented decoder; adversarial search over worst-case mixtures of feature styles plus noise.
evidence: Better OOD robustness on cardiac and prostate MR under corruptions, site shift and unseen sequences, in low and high data settings (abstract).
adaptation: Add an aux reconstruction decoder to U-Net++; perturb encoder feature mean/std adversarially.
min_experiment: PF+MaxStyle vs PF+GIN-IPA; E1 relF1@2; kill if < +0.02 over GIN-IPA.
